home.title: VoiceID
home.subtitle: Identify · Clone · Analyze
home.description: A voice intelligence platform built on speaker embeddings — developed as part of our L3 MIASHS internship at Dell Technologies.

feature_recognition.title: Voice Recognition
feature_recognition.desc: Submit any audio clip and match it against every registered profile in the database using speaker embeddings.

feature_cloning.title: Voice Cloning
feature_cloning.desc: Clone your registered voice across languages, emotional tones, and styles using Fun-CosyVoice 3.0.

feature_registration.title: Registration
feature_registration.desc: Create an account and record your voice. Your vocal profile is encoded and stored — the first step to recognition and cloning.

feature_stats.title: Statistics
feature_stats.desc: Explore recognition accuracy, false-positive rates, speaker clustering visualizations, and model performance benchmarks.

home.step1_desc: Create an account and submit a voice sample. Your voice is encoded as a 192-dimension speaker embedding and stored in the Qdrant vector database.
home.step2_desc: Feed any clip to the recognition engine for a cosine similarity search across all profiles — or synthesize new speech from your registered voice.
home.step3_desc: Review recognition accuracy, false-positive rates, and speaker clustering metrics in the Statistics panel.
home.cloning_intro: Once registered, your voice becomes a synthesis template. The engine — built on CosyVoice (Fun-CosyVoice3-0.5B) — supports four distinct modes:
home.cloning_mode1: Zero-shot — synthesize from a short reference clip only
home.cloning_mode2: Cross-lingual — keep your timbre, speak in another language
home.cloning_mode3: Guided instruction — Select emotion and speaking style
home.cloning_mode4: Custom instruction — guide emotion, pace, and tone via a text prompt
home.context_dell_desc: This project was developed in order to showcase the possible results of a two-month voice recognition project using only open-source tools.
home.context_uni_desc: We did this internship in the conclusion of our third year of the MIASHS programme — Mathematics and Computer Science Applied to Humanities and Social Sciences — at Université Paul Valéry Montpellier.
home.footer: VoiceID · L3 MIASHS · Université Paul Valéry Montpellier · Dell Technologies Internship 2026

register.title: Create an account
register.consent_text: I accept the vectorization and use of my voice for voice recognition.
register.error_audio_file: Please record or import an audio file of your voice
register.error_consent: Please accept the consent charter to create an account
register.consent_intro: By creating an account on this site, I consent to my voice being vectorized upon account registration and stored by VoiceID to be used exclusively for voice recognition purposes.
register.consent_section2_text: In the context of voice recognition, we collect and process:
register.consent_section2_item1: A recording of your voice at the time of account creation
register.consent_section2_item2: A vectorial representation of your voice generated by the SpeechBrain tool (digital voice fingerprint)
register.consent_section2_important: Your voice is not stored as an audio file, but as a vector. It is therefore impossible for us to replay your recording; only a digital representation (characteristics/tone of your voice) is retained to enable voice authentication.
register.consent_section3: Purposes and Legal Basis for Processing (GDPR)
register.consent_section3_text: Your voice data is processed for the following purposes:
register.consent_section3_item1: Authentication and securing access to your account via voice recognition
register.consent_section3_item2: Improving and maintaining the quality of the voice recognition system
register.consent_section3_legal: Legal basis: Your explicit consent (Article 6.1.a of the GDPR), collected when creating your account via the dedicated checkbox.
register.consent_section4_text: Your voice data (voice vector) is retained:
register.consent_section4_item1: For the entire duration of your account
register.consent_section4_item2: Then deleted or anonymized within seconds of your account deletion
register.consent_section5: Withdrawal of Consent and Account Deletion
register.consent_section5_text: You can withdraw your consent at any time by deleting your account via the account management page. Deleting your account results in the deletion of data associated with your voice, within the timeframes indicated above.
register.consent_section6_text: Your voice data is accessible only:
register.consent_section6_item: On the local machine on which VoiceID has been installed
register.consent_section6_important: Your data will not be sold or transferred to third parties for commercial purposes.
register.consent_section7_text: No transfer: Your data is not transferred outside the European Union.
register.consent_section8_text: Your voice data will not be used for commercial purposes. No promotional messages will be sent to you based on this data.

cloning.engine_description: Fun-CosyVoice 3.0 is an advanced text-to-speech (TTS) system based on large language models (LLM), surpassing its predecessor (CosyVoice 2.0) in content consistency, speaker similarity, and prosody naturalness. It is designed for zero-shot multilingual speech synthesis in the wild.
